Valuation source check: PARTIAL
2026-11-02 deep analysis. Q2 2026 primary release: FCF before working capital 3,021m, principal debt 11,818m (YE2025 20,427m), cash 4,150m; OxyChem sale closed 2 Jan 2026 (adjusted 9,472m). Berkshire 10-Q: ~8.5bn 8% preferred, redeemable Aug 2029 at 105%; 83.9m warrants at 59.59 USD. The model NGV 115.92 USD equals FY2022-25 mean FCF 7,051m (12,313/6,612/5,176/4,105) per share at ~6.1%; the mean includes 2022 peak oil and pre-sale OxyChem periods, and fcf/shares ignores 680m/yr preferred dividends. Conditional, unapproved research DCF (10% cost of equity, 4,800m pre-preferred FCF at 65 USD WTI, 230m per 1 USD/bbl): bear/base/bull 38.79/63.14/96.10 USD with mid-cycle WTI 62/70/82; probability-weighted 64.08 USD at p 30/45/25. At the ~61.70 USD reference (2 Nov intraday) implied long-run WTI is about 69-73 USD versus ~69 USD for the Dec-2028 future (24 Aug). Commodity normalization, OxyChem-free annual cash flow and the Tronox tax contingency (~2.4bn) remain unverified. Report: https://usubillaga.github.io/InvestorAce/earnings/oxy-deep-dive-2026-11-02.html

Only dates strictly before the current exchange-local date are used, even after today’s close. This conservative policy can lag one completed session. At least 200 valid bars are required for metrics. Signal comparisons need at least 201 valid completed bars. BUY: previous close ≤ previous EMA 21, latest close > EMA 21 and SMA 200. SELL: previous close ≥ previous SMA 200, latest close < SMA 200. Events are labels for review; existing verdicts and actions are unchanged. EMA 21 uses an initial 21-close mean; ATR 14 uses a 14-true-range mean followed by Wilder smoothing (first TR = High − Low). More than 7 calendar days of lag is flagged STALE. The adjusted historical close can differ from the current quote. Values and an input-window hash are archived as observed; raw OHLC is not archived and provider adjustments can change on refetch. Performance advantage has not been established.
